title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・どでけえ好敵手よ

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (Now's my chance to beat 'em! I've gotta run like my life depends on it!)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Inari One steals the lead! There she goes! Inari One takes first!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (Hehe… I can barely stand. Runnin' next to those two's left me all in tatters!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: To tell the truth, I underestimated ya. It's my loss today.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But stayin' a loser doesn't sit right with me. I'll definitely take ya down a notch, so ya better watch out.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Let's do this again at the next autumn Tenno Sho, Inari.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Sure thing! Get ready for round two, right here at Tokyo Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (Hehe… That's one big promise I just made!)
